messages:
morgan: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8412 — changes KV-cache eviction heuristic to a weighted-LRU window. hoping to cut p99 for short sequences. blocked on architecture alignment with RFC-342 (link below) before merge.

RFC: https://redwood-inference.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/123456789/RFC-342-KV-Cache-Eviction
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8412

alex: quick question — does this change the serialized cache key or on-disk layout? if so we need a migration story.

morgan: no key format change, keys stay identical. it's purely eviction ordering + heuristics. that said it can shift latency tail which we should guard with canary + auto-fallback.

lena: adding @sam for perf numbers. also looping in arch for a quick signoff — @alex can you review once sam posts numbers? :eyes: 

sam: ran a couple local runs on A100/rtx bench. short seqs improved (p50/p90) but noticed a small p99 regression for long sequences on quantized runs. gist here: https://gist.github.com/sam/abc123 — baseline vs new-policy.

morgan: ok good catch. I'll add canary flags and an abort hook that resets eviction to current policy if p99 > baseline by 5%. planning to add those checks in the PR.

ci-bot: CI checks passed — 12/12 — unit + integration.

ops-bot: preview deployment available at https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/8412 — canary enabled = false by default.

alex: RFC-342 has a compatibility section that expects an explicit migration/canary plan. we can't merge without a short RFC update or a clear note in the RFC about the fallback plan. can you add that, @morgan? :calendar:

morgan: will update RFC today — will add canary rollout, abort conditions, and how we backfill evicted entries (if needed). also added a one-paragraph summary to the PR describing expected metrics impact.

lena: once RFC is updated i'm +1 from platform side. small prefer a 15-min sync tomorrow to walk through the abort logic if anyone wants.

sam: also requested in PR: add the metric names to watch — cache_hit_ratio, kv_evictions_per_min, p99_inference_latency. automated alert if p99 increases >5% for 15m.

morgan: updated PR & RFC, added canary flags + metric checks, linked both in PR description. tagging for architecture review: @alex @lena. requesting explicit arch ack before merge.

alex: I'll review and post feedback by EOD. if the RFC update looks good and canary confirms within 2 hours, we can merge and promote. otherwise we'll hold.

morgan: thanks — holding merge until arch ack and canary green. ping me here if you want the quick 15-min walkthrough.
